about.title: About the scheduling system
about.tagline: Create and manage work schedules and keep your team informed in one place.
about.system.title: About the system
about.system.p1: {app} is a self-hosted work schedule management system for teams that need to create, publish and review shift schedules.
about.system.p2: The system combines schedule planning, employee access, change tracking and notifications in one web application designed for desktop and mobile use.
about.features.title: Main features
about.features.schedules.title: Work schedules
about.features.schedules.text: Create, edit, publish and archive shift schedules.
about.features.shifts.title: Shift types
about.features.shifts.text: Define working hours, colors and other shift parameters.
about.features.employees.title: Employee profiles
about.features.employees.text: Manage employees, their profiles and schedule visibility.
about.features.roles.title: Roles and permissions
about.features.roles.text: Control access to system features and information.
about.features.days_off.title: Day-off requests
about.features.days_off.text: Employees can submit their preferred days off.
about.features.acknowledgements.title: Schedule acknowledgements
about.features.acknowledgements.text: Track which employees have reviewed a published schedule.
about.features.notifications.title: Notifications
about.features.notifications.text: Inform users about schedule publications and changes.
about.features.history.title: Activity history
about.features.history.text: Keep a record of important administrator and user actions.
about.modular.title: Modular architecture
about.modular.p1: Additional functionality is divided into modules that can be enabled or disabled for each installation.
about.modular.p2: This keeps the core simple while allowing the system to grow when needed.
about.access.title: Access
about.access.text: User accounts are created through a controlled process. When the invitation module is enabled, an administrator can generate a single-use invitation link for a new user.
about.hosting.title: Self-hosting
about.hosting.text: {app} is intended for deployment on your own PHP and MySQL/MariaDB server. Installation settings are stored in a local .env file that must not be committed to version control.
about.legal.title: Author, source code and license
